name: Sunita Devi
story: I got a call from someone saying they were from my bank. They said my account would be blocked and asked for the OTP I just received. I shared it and within minutes ₹18,000 was gone from my account. I called 1930 immediately and they froze the account. I got back ₹12,000.
lesson: Real banks NEVER ask for OTP on phone. Hang up immediately and call your bank directly.

name: Rekha Kumari
story: I was added to a Telegram group promising ₹500-1000 per day for simple tasks like liking YouTube videos. At first I got small payments to build trust. Then they asked me to invest ₹5,000 to unlock bigger tasks. I paid and they disappeared with the group.
lesson: No real job pays you for liking videos. Any 'task' that requires you to invest money first is a scam.

name: Priya Sharma
story: Someone sent me a message saying they had edited my profile photo and would send it to my family and SHG group unless I paid ₹10,000. I was scared but my daughter told me not to pay. We reported to cybercrime.gov.in and called 1930. The person was traced.
outcome: Reported to 1930 — scammer traced by police
lesson: NEVER pay a blackmailer. Report immediately to 1930. Paying once leads to more demands.

name: Anita Patel
story: A man contacted me on Facebook saying he was an army officer posted abroad. After 3 months of chatting he said he needed ₹25,000 for medical emergency. I sent money twice thinking he was genuine. He then stopped responding.
lesson: Never send money to someone you have only met online, no matter how long you have known them.

name: Meena Devi
story: I got a call that sounded exactly like my son saying he had an accident and needed ₹30,000 urgently. I was about to transfer when my neighbour asked me to call my son directly first. He was safe at home. The voice was AI-generated.
outcome: No money lost — stopped in time
lesson: Always hang up and call back on the person's saved number before sending any money.
